text:
Maria Chen: quick heads-up — int4-ensemble-v2p3 promoted to 10% earlier today hit a stability flag on a short-answer slice (finance-defs). A/B shows 2.4% drop vs baseline on the definitional slice. latency is fine but quality regressed.

Sven Petrov: saw the alerts. that's above our 1.5% auto-fallback threshold. did the promote job have fallback=auto enabled?

Maria Chen: promote config claimed auto-fallback=on, but logs suggest the comparator used was `weighted_mrr` not `slice_exact_match` for this slice so the drift didn't trip the rule.

Aj Taylor: `promote inspect 5864001234` shows comparator=weighted_mrr, window=1h. yeah, not surprising it missed a short-answer exact-match drop.

Lee Gomez: can we manual-fallback now while fixing comparator? ops console still shows 10% routed. if we flip comparator and re-eval on a shadow pass how long to get a reliable signal?

Sven Petrov: kicking a shadow re-run now against archived traffic. command: 
```bash
./shadow_runner --variant int4-ensemble-v2p3 --slice finance-defs --compare slice_exact_match --window 1h
```

oncall-bot: shadow run job j-98321 started. ETA ~8m. will post results here.

Maria Chen: also noticed subtle quantization artifact on trailing tokens in multi-turn — samples attached in eval artifact. Not huge but consistent on the definitional slice.

Aj Taylor: recommend immediate manual-fallback for the 10% cohort until comparator is fixed and shadow confirms. manual command: `rl-promote --variant baseline --force-fallback --cohort 10%`

Sven Petrov: executed manual fallback. traffic shifted, confirmed baseline back to 10%. monitoring alerts suppressed with annotation.

Maria Chen: thanks. follow-ups: 1) change promote config to use slice-specific comparator for short-answer slices, 2) add a hallucination_count signal to the gating logic, 3) run a 1h shadow with exact_match comparator before any auto-promote. I'll open a PR for config + tests.

Lee Gomez: propose new canary rule: if any slice delta > 1.0% on `exact_match` OR hallucination_count delta > 0.8%, trigger auto-fallback. also require comparator to be explicitly set per-slice or deny auto-fallback.

Maria Chen: agreed. I'll include that wording in the PR and attach the shadow job logs + sample diffs. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: alert cleared at 5864001620. shadow job j-98321 completed, summary posted to the eval artifact link.

Sven Petrov: once PR merges we'll schedule a dry-run where auto-fallback is enabled in `monitor-only` mode to validate triggers.

Maria Chen: filing follow-up tickets and will ping infra for a backfill run for the older traffic slices. thanks everyone.
